question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect voice.**

The professor said, "The students who had been absent yesterday will have to submit their assignments by tomorrow, or they will be penalized."

options.text: The professor said that the students who had been absent the day before would have to submit their assignments by the next day, or they would be penalized.
The professor said that the students who were absent yesterday would have to submit their assignments by tomorrow, or they will be penalized.
The professor said that the students who had been absent the day before will have to submit their assignments by tomorrow, or they will be penalized.
The professor said that the students who were absent the day before would have to submit their assignments by tomorrow, or they would be penalized.

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. The professor said that the students who had been absent the day before would have to submit their assignments by the next day, or they would be penalized.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **direct speech**, and the task is to convert it into **indirect speech.**
 
• When converting direct speech to indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb **“said”** remains unchanged as there is no request or command.
 
• Time expressions such as **“yesterday”** change to **“the day before”**, and **“tomorrow”** changes to **“the next day.”**
 
• The tense of the reported speech shifts one step back in time. For example:
 
 
• **“will”** changes to **“would.”**
 
• **“had been”** remains unchanged as it is already in the past perfect tense.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct option must reflect these changes accurately.

Correct sentence: *The professor said that the students who had been absent the day before would have to submit their assignments by the next day, or they would be penalized.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Changes in Time Expressions:**
 
 
• **Direct Speech:** yesterday → **Indirect Speech:** the day before
 
• **Direct Speech:** tomorrow → **Indirect Speech:** the next day
 
 
 
• **Changes in Tenses:**
 
 
• **Direct Speech:** will → **Indirect Speech:** would
 
• **Direct Speech:** present/past tense → **Indirect Speech:** past/past perfect tense
